claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment such as inverter, panels, charge...
claims.evidence: This is a general business description, not a verifiable fact about the specific panels in the photo; no shop signage, registration, or matching branding visible in the report.

risks.risk: Wattage/power rating of each panel is unknown; no legible nameplate.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating label/sticker on the back of each panel showing Wp, Voc, Isc.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced from a wattage-based list until rating is confirmed; treat as unknown spec, lowest plausible tier.

risks.risk: Cell condition (micro-cracks, hotspots, delamination) not visible from the front shot.
risks.proof: Close-up daylight photos of each cell surface, or an EL/thermal image if available.

risks.risk: No output test performed; actual power delivery unverified.
risks.proof: Video of panel in sunlight connected to a multimeter/charge controller showing voltage and current.

risks.risk: Junction box and MC4 connectors/cables condition and presence not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the reverse side showing junction box and connector ends.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing/damaged connectors, buyer to add cost of replacement.

risks.risk: Frame and edge damage on the back or corners not visible.
risks.proof: Photos of the full reverse side and all four edges/corners.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically/structurally unverified, worst-case minor frame damage assumed.

risks.risk: Age and usage history unknown, affecting expected remaining lifespan.
risks.proof: No remote proof possible; seller could provide purchase date/receipt photo as partial evidence.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the rating label on each panel (Wp, Voc, Isc, model/brand).
Photos of the full back side of both panels including junction box and connectors.
Video of the panels under sunlight connected to a multimeter or small load showing live voltage/current.
Close-up photos of all frame edges and corners for cracks or bends.
Any purchase receipt or warranty card photo if available.
response.reason: The witness report confirms the item is solar panels but no wattage, voltage, or brand/model is legible, and this spec is what sets the price tier in any panel price list; without it even a worst-case price cannot be looked up.
